```yaml
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Every pull request and push: complexity limits, shell scripts, and (on pull requests) commit
# subjects and size. The limits are in CONTRIBUTING.md; nothing here installs anything unpinned.
name: Quality
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  complexity:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install lizard (pinned by hash)
        run: python3 -m pip install --user --require-hashes --no-deps -r tools/requirements-ci.txt
      - name: Complexity, length and parameters per function (make lint)
        run: PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" make lint

  shell:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: shellcheck every shell script (by extension or shebang)
        run: |
          mapfile -t scripts < <(git ls-files | while read -r f; do
            case "$f" in *.sh) echo "$f"; continue ;; esac
            head -n1 -- "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '^#!.*\b(ba|da|k)?sh\b' && echo "$f"
          done)
          echo "${#scripts[@]} shell scripts"
          [ "${#scripts[@]}" -eq 0 ] || shellcheck "${scripts[@]}"

  pull-request:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Commit subjects and size (tools/pr-shape)
        env:
          BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          LABELS: ${{ join(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, ' ') }}
        run: |
          args=()
          for l in $LABELS; do args+=(--label "$l"); done
          python3 tools/pr-shape "$BASE" "$HEAD" "${args[@]}"
```

================================================================================
FILE: .github/workflows/release.yml    [Build and run: .github/workflows/release.yml]
================================================================================

```yaml
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# A release: pushing a signed tag v* builds, scans, checksums and attests the assets, and creates a DRAFT
# GitHub release for the maintainer to publish. Nothing is published by this workflow.
#
#   source + library (Linux)  ->  plugins (macOS, CLAP/VST3/AUv2)  ->  sign (skipped until the Developer ID
#   secrets exist)  ->  SHA256SUMS + build-provenance attestation + draft release
#
# Plugins are ad-hoc signed until the secrets named in tools/release-signing are set in the
# Environment `release`; then the `sign` job signs with Developer ID, builds a signed installer,
# notarizes (the installer is stapled; a plug-in folder cannot be) and verifies. With none of them set that job skips signing, says so in its log and
# in the release notes. The attestation covers the final signed and notarized files.
# Actions are pinned to full commit SHAs.
name: Release
on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*']
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
env:
  TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
jobs:
  verify-tag:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: The tag is a signed tag that GitHub shows as Verified
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ref=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/ref/tags/$TAG")
          [ "$(jq -r .object.type <<<"$ref")" = tag ] || { echo "::error::$TAG is a lightweight tag: create it with git tag -s"; exit 1; }
          tag=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/tags/$(jq -r .object.sha <<<"$ref")")
          [ "$(jq -r .verification.verified <<<"$tag")" = true ] || {
            echo "::error::$TAG is not verified: $(jq -r .verification.reason <<<"$tag")"; exit 1; }

  source:
    needs: verify-tag
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Published files match EXPORTED
        run: python3 tools/export-public dsp --verify .
      - name: gitleaks 8.30.1 (pinned release, checksum checked)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL -o gl.tgz https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v8.30.1/gitleaks_8.30.1_linux_x64.tar.gz
          echo "551f6fc83ea457d62a0d98237cbad105af8d557003051f41f3e7ca7b3f2470eb  gl.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/gl" && tar -xzf gl.tgz -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/gl" gitleaks && rm gl.tgz
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/gl/gitleaks" dir . --no-banner --redact
      - name: The release scanner passes its own tests, then the tree is scanned
        run: |
          python3 tools/test-release-scan
          python3 tools/test-release-signing
          python3 tools/release-scan .
      - name: Headers, library and tests (ASan + UBSan, TSan)
        run: |
          sudo sysctl -w vm.mmap_rnd_bits=28
          make headers lib test CXX=clang++
      - name: Release library (build paths mapped out) and source archive
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          make lib BUILD=build-release CXX="clang++ -ffile-prefix-map=$PWD=."
          python3 tools/release-scan build-release/libsquatch-dsp.a
          mkdir dist
          cp build-release/libsquatch-dsp.a "dist/libsquatch-dsp-$TAG-linux-x86_64.a"
          git archive --format=tar.gz --prefix="squatch-dsp-${TAG#v}/" -o "dist/squatch-dsp-$TAG-source.tar.gz" "$GITHUB_SHA"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: source
          path: dist/*
          if-no-files-found: error

  plugins:
    needs: verify-tag
    runs-on: macos-15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Pinned plugin dependencies (hosts/clap/deps.lock; each commit checked)
        run: |
          cmake --version | head -1; ninja --version
          tools/fetch-plugin-deps --repos-only
      - name: Build CLAP, VST3 and AUv2, universal, build paths mapped out
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          MAP="-ffile-prefix-map=$PWD=. -fdebug-prefix-map=$PWD=."
          cmake -S hosts/clap -B build/plugins -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
            -DCMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES="arm64;x86_64" \
            -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="$MAP" -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="$MAP" -DCMAKE_OBJC_FLAGS="$MAP" -DCMAKE_OBJCXX_FLAGS="$MAP"
          cmake --build build/plugins
          ls build/plugins/bundles
          for ext in clap vst3 component; do
            n=$(find build/plugins/bundles -maxdepth 1 -name "*.$ext" | wc -l); echo "$ext: $n bundles"
            [ "$n" -ge 10 ] || { echo "::error::expected at least 10 .$ext bundles"; exit 1; }
          done
      - name: Scan the bundles, and check architectures and the ad-hoc signature
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 tools/release-scan build/plugins/bundles
          for b in build/plugins/bundles/*; do
            exe="$b/Contents/MacOS/$(defaults read "$PWD/$b/Contents/Info" CFBundleExecutable)"
            archs=$(lipo -archs "$exe"); case "$archs" in *arm64*x86_64*|*x86_64*arm64*) ;; *) echo "::error::$b is $archs"; exit 1;; esac
            codesign --verify --strict "$b"
          done
      - name: Package (unsigned), plus the macOS library
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p stage/CLAP stage/VST3 stage/Components dist
          for p in build/plugins/bundles/*.clap; do ditto "$p" "stage/CLAP/$(basename "$p")"; done
          for p in build/plugins/bundles/*.vst3; do ditto "$p" "stage/VST3/$(basename "$p")"; done
          for p in build/plugins/bundles/*.component; do ditto "$p" "stage/Components/$(basename "$p")"; done
          ditto -c -k --keepParent stage dist/plugins-unsigned.zip
          make lib BUILD=build-release CXX="clang++ -ffile-prefix-map=$PWD=."
          python3 tools/release-scan build-release/libsquatch-dsp.a
          cp build-release/libsquatch-dsp.a "dist/libsquatch-dsp-$TAG-macos-arm64.a"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: plugins-unsigned
          path: dist/plugins-unsigned.zip
          if-no-files-found: error
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: library-macos
          path: dist/libsquatch-dsp-*-macos-arm64.a
          if-no-files-found: error

  # Signs, notarizes and verifies in the Environment `release`: it has a required reviewer (every run waits
  # for the maintainer's approval) and only tag refs may use it. The certificates and the notarization key
  # are that environment's secrets (tools/release-signing says which); with none of them set the ad-hoc
  # build passes through, labelled as such. A temporary keychain holds the certificates and is deleted.
  sign:
    needs: plugins
    runs-on: macos-15
    environment: release
    outputs:
      signing: ${{ steps.check.outputs.signing }}
    env:
      MACOS_APP_CERT_P12: ${{ secrets.MACOS_APP_CERT_P12 }}
      MACOS_INSTALLER_CERT_P12: ${{ secrets.MACOS_INSTALLER_CERT_P12 }}
      MACOS_CERT_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERT_PASSWORD }}
      ASC_KEY_P8: ${{ secrets.ASC_KEY_P8 }}
      ASC_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.ASC_KEY_ID }}
      ASC_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.ASC_ISSUER_ID }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: plugins-unsigned
      - name: Are the signing secrets set? (skips cleanly when none are)
        id: check
        run: |
          rc=0; tools/release-signing check --installer --github-output "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" || rc=$?
          case $rc in 0) ;; 10) echo "::notice title=Signing skipped::No signing secrets: the plugins are ad-hoc signed only. Set them in the Environment 'release'.";; *) exit "$rc";; esac
      - name: Temporary keychain with both Developer ID certificates
        if: steps.check.outputs.signing == 'yes'
        run: tools/release-signing keychain --installer
      - name: Sign the bundles (Developer ID Application, hardened runtime, secure timestamp)
        if: steps.check.outputs.signing == 'yes'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ditto -x -k plugins-unsigned.zip .
          tools/release-signing sign stage/CLAP/*.clap stage/VST3/*.vst3 stage/Components/*.component
      - name: Notarize the bundles and zip them (stapler cannot staple a plug-in folder; the installer is stapled)
        if: steps.check.outputs.signing == 'yes'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p out notarize
          ditto -c -k --keepParent stage notarize/bundles.zip
          tools/release-signing notarize notarize/bundles.zip
          ditto -c -k --keepParent stage "out/squatch-dsp-plugins-$TAG-macos.zip"
      - name: Installer (Developer ID Installer), notarized and stapled
        if: steps.check.outputs.signing == 'yes'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The installer lays the notarized bundles down in the system plug-in folders.
          for pair in CLAP:CLAP VST3:VST3 Components:Components; do
            mkdir -p "pkgroot/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/${pair#*:}"; ditto "stage/${pair%%:*}" "pkgroot/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/${pair#*:}"
          done
          tools/release-signing pkg --root pkgroot --identifier cc.squatch.dsp-plugins --version "${TAG#v}" \
            --install-location / --out "out/squatch-dsp-plugins-$TAG-macos.pkg"
          tools/release-signing notarize "out/squatch-dsp-plugins-$TAG-macos.pkg"
      - name: Verify what will ship (spctl, pkgutil, stapler, codesign, auval -strict)
        if: steps.check.outputs.signing == 'yes'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tools/release-signing verify "out/squatch-dsp-plugins-$TAG-macos.pkg" stage/CLAP/*.clap stage/VST3/*.vst3 stage/Components/*.component
          tools/release-signing verify-au --manufacturer SqSt stage/Components
      - name: Ad-hoc build passes through, named for what it is
        if: steps.check.outputs.signing != 'yes'
        run: |
          mkdir out
          cp plugins-unsigned.zip "out/squatch-dsp-plugins-$TAG-macos-adhoc-unsigned.zip"
      - name: Delete the temporary keychain and key files
        if: always()
        run: tools/release-signing cleanup
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: plugins
          path: out/*
          if-no-files-found: error

  release:
    needs: [source, sign, plugins]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: write       # the draft release
      id-token: write       # the attestation's signing identity
      attestations: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true
          pattern: '{source,library-macos,plugins}'
      - name: Checksums
        working-directory: dist
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ls -l
          sha256sum -- * > SHA256SUMS
          cat SHA256SUMS
      - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: dist/*
      - name: Draft release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          SIGNING: ${{ needs.sign.outputs.signing }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$SIGNING" = yes ]; then
            status="The plugins and installer are signed with Developer ID and notarized."
          else
            status="**The plugins are ad-hoc signed and not notarized** (Developer ID certificates are not installed yet), so macOS will warn on first launch. This release is a draft until that is done."
          fi
          cat > notes.md <<NOTES
          Squatch DSP $TAG.

          - \`squatch-dsp-$TAG-source.tar.gz\`: the source.
          - \`libsquatch-dsp-$TAG-linux-x86_64.a\`, \`libsquatch-dsp-$TAG-macos-arm64.a\`: the core library.
          - \`squatch-dsp-plugins-$TAG-macos*\`: Squatch Tuner, Gate, Limiter, EQ, Cab, Trail OD, Claw, Crunch, Comp and Hall as CLAP, VST3 and AUv2 (universal: Apple silicon and Intel).

          $status

          Verify what you downloaded:

          \`\`\`sh
          shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS            # sha256sum -c on Linux
          gh attestation verify FILE -R $GITHUB_REPOSITORY
          \`\`\`

          The tag $TAG is SSH-signed and shows Verified on GitHub. The attestation names this repository's release workflow and the tagged commit.
          NOTES
          flags=(--draft --verify-tag --title "Squatch DSP $TAG" --notes-file notes.md)
          case "$TAG" in *-*) flags+=(--prerelease);; esac
          gh release create "$TAG" dist/* "${flags[@]}"
```

================================================================================
FILE: Makefile    [Build and run: Makefile]
================================================================================

```
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# squatch-dsp: the core library, its tests and benchmarks. System clang++, no fetched dependencies.
# clang++ where it exists (this Mac), g++ otherwise (the Pi). CXX=... on the command line wins.
ifeq ($(origin CXX),default)
CXX := $(if $(shell command -v clang++ 2>/dev/null),clang++,g++)
endif
ifeq ($(origin CC),default)
CC := $(if $(shell command -v clang 2>/dev/null),clang,gcc)
endif
BUILD := build
UNAME := $(shell uname -s)

WARN := -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Werror
CORE := -std=c++17 -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti $(WARN) -Iinclude -Iblocks/tuner/include
RELEASE := $(CORE) -O3
SANITIZE := $(CORE) -O1 -g -fno-omit-frame-pointer -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all
TSAN := $(CORE) -O1 -g -fsanitize=thread

HEADERS := $(shell find include -name '*.hpp')
SRC := $(wildcard src/*.cpp)
OBJ := $(SRC:src/%.cpp=$(BUILD)/obj/%.o)
TEST_SRC := $(filter-out tests/test_queue_threads.cpp,$(wildcard tests/*.cpp))
TEST_DEPS := $(wildcard tests/*.hpp) $(wildcard tests/golden/*.inc)

# Locks taken inside process() are counted by an interposing dylib (dyld honours __interpose in
# a linked library). Elsewhere the lock check is reported as unmeasured, never as passed.
ifeq ($(UNAME),Darwin)
LOCKS := $(BUILD)/liblockcount.dylib
LOCK_LINK := -L$(BUILD) -llockcount -Wl,-rpath,@loader_path
BENCH_OUT ?= results/bench-mac.md
else
TEST_DEFS := -DSQUATCH_NO_LOCK_COUNT
BENCH_OUT ?= results/bench-$(shell uname -m).md
endif

.PHONY: all lib test lint headers bench golden ci live rig wasm wasm-test wasm-shots record-session-test clean FORCE \
        contracts contracts-check tuner-csv plugins plugins-install plugins-check export-check release-scan-test lv2 lv2-linux
all: lib $(BUILD)/tests $(BUILD)/bench

# The core as the targets build it: optimised, no exceptions, no RTTI.
lib: $(BUILD)/libsquatch-dsp.a

$(BUILD)/obj/%.o: src/%.cpp $(HEADERS) $(wildcard blocks/tuner/include/squatch/tuner/*.hpp) | $(BUILD)/obj
	$(CXX) $(RELEASE) -c -o $@ $<

$(BUILD)/libsquatch-dsp.a: $(OBJ)
	ar rcs $@ $^

$(BUILD)/liblockcount.dylib: tests/lockcount.c | $(BUILD)
	$(CC) -O1 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -dynamiclib -o $@ $<

# Tests compile the sources again with ASan and UBSan.
# The tuner's headers live under blocks/, outside $(HEADERS); without them here an edit to tuner.hpp left the
# test binary stale and every tuner test passed against the old code (found 2026-10-02).
$(BUILD)/tests: $(TEST_SRC) $(SRC) $(HEADERS) $(wildcard blocks/tuner/include/squatch/tuner/*.hpp) $(TEST_DEPS) $(LOCKS) | $(BUILD)
	$(CXX) $(SANITIZE) $(TEST_DEFS) -o $@ $(TEST_SRC) $(SRC) $(LOCK_LINK)

# The Seed3 firmware's measurement code and its overdrive block, on this machine, with ASan, UBSan
# and the allocation watch. The firmware itself is `make -C hosts/daisy` (arm-none-eabi-gcc). The
# development tree only: the public export has no hosts/daisy, and `make test` skips this then.
DAISY := $(wildcard hosts/daisy/tests)
ifneq ($(DAISY),)
DAISY_TEST_SRC := $(wildcard hosts/daisy/tests/*.cpp) tests/runner.cpp tests/rt_watch.cpp
DAISY_HEADERS := $(wildcard hosts/daisy/common/*.hpp hosts/daisy/faust/*.hpp)
$(BUILD)/test_daisy: $(DAISY_TEST_SRC) $(DAISY_HEADERS) $(HEADERS) $(LOCKS) | $(BUILD)
	$(CXX) $(SANITIZE) $(TEST_DEFS) -o $@ $(DAISY_TEST_SRC) $(LOCK_LINK)
endif

# The parameter queue is tested across threads, so it gets ThreadSanitizer instead.
$(BUILD)/test_queue_threads: tests/test_queue_threads.cpp $(HEADERS) | $(BUILD)
	$(CXX) $(TSAN) -o $@ $< -lpthread

# Hosts (hosts/): not core, so exceptions are allowed, but the same warnings. The host layer's
# handoff is tested for data races with TSan, which refuses the Pi 5's 47-bit address space:
# there, `make test HOST_SAN=`.
HOST := -std=c++17 -O3 $(WARN) -Iinclude -Iblocks/tuner/include
HOST_SAN ?= -fsanitize=thread
HOST_HEADERS := $(wildcard hosts/common/*.hpp) $(wildcard hosts/jack/*.hpp) $(HEADERS)
TUNER_HEADERS := $(wildcard blocks/tuner/include/squatch/tuner/*.hpp)

$(BUILD)/test_hosts: hosts/tests/test_hosts.cpp $(HOST_HEADERS) $(TUNER_HEADERS) | $(BUILD)
	$(CXX) $(HOST) -O1 -g $(HOST_SAN) -o $@ $< -lpthread

# The live JACK tuner and its test-tone generator. Needs the JACK headers (libjack-jackd2-dev):
# built on the Pi bench, not part of `all`. hosts/pi/ expects them in build/.
live: $(BUILD)/squatch-tuner-live $(BUILD)/squatch-tone

$(BUILD)/squatch-tuner-live: hosts/jack/tuner_live.cpp $(HOST_HEADERS) $(TUNER_HEADERS) | $(BUILD)
	$(CXX) $(HOST) -o $@ $< -ljack -lpthread

$(BUILD)/squatch-tone: hosts/jack/tone.cpp $(HOST_HEADERS) | $(BUILD)
	$(CXX) $(HOST) -o $@ $< -ljack -lpthread

# The live rig (gate, tuner, amp, cabinet, EQ, limiter as one JACK client) and the loopback
# latency probe. JACK headers as for `live`; not part of `all`. The amp stage runs NAM Core,
# which is optional and never part of the library: name a checkout with NAM_CORE=DIR (its NAM/
# sources; Eigen and nlohmann/json from NAM_EIGEN and NAM_JSON, by default its Dependencies/).
# Without NAM_CORE the rig builds and runs with the amp bypassed.
NAM_CORE ?=
NAM_EIGEN ?= $(NAM_CORE)/Dependencies/eigen
NAM_JSON ?= $(NAM_CORE)/Dependencies/nlohmann
NAM_ARCH ?= $(if $(filter Linux-aarch64,$(UNAME)-$(shell uname -m)),-mcpu=native,)
NAM_INC := -isystem $(NAM_CORE) -isystem $(NAM_EIGEN) -isystem $(NAM_JSON)
NAM_FLAGS := -std=c++17 -O3 -DNDEBUG $(NAM_ARCH) -DNAM_SAMPLE_FLOAT -DNAM_ENABLE_A2_FAST -DEIGEN_DONT_PARALLELIZE $(NAM_INC)
NAM_SRC := $(if $(NAM_CORE),$(wildcard $(NAM_CORE)/NAM/*.cpp $(NAM_CORE)/NAM/wavenet/*.cpp))
NAM_OBJ := $(patsubst $(NAM_CORE)/NAM/%.cpp,$(BUILD)/nam/%.o,$(NAM_SRC))
RIG_NAM := $(if $(NAM_CORE),-DSQUATCH_WITH_NAM -DNDEBUG -DNAM_SAMPLE_FLOAT -DNAM_ENABLE_A2_FAST -DEIGEN_DONT_PARALLELIZE $(NAM_INC))
RIG_HEADERS := $(wildcard hosts/jack/rig_*.hpp) hosts/jack/nam_amp.hpp hosts/common/ir_file.hpp

rig: $(BUILD)/squatch-rig-live $(BUILD)/squatch-latency

# Rebuilds the rig when NAM_CORE changes (with or without the amp).
$(BUILD)/rig.cfg: FORCE | $(BUILD)
	@echo '$(NAM_CORE)' | cmp -s - $@ || echo '$(NAM_CORE)' > $@

$(BUILD)/nam/%.o: $(NAM_CORE)/NAM/%.cpp
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	$(CXX) $(NAM_FLAGS) -c -o $@ $<

$(BUILD)/squatch-rig-live: hosts/jack/rig_live.cpp $(RIG_HEADERS) $(HOST_HEADERS) $(TUNER_HEADERS) $(BUILD)/libsquatch-dsp.a \
                           $(NAM_OBJ) $(BUILD)/rig.cfg | $(BUILD)
	$(CXX) $(HOST) $(RIG_NAM) -o $@ $< $(NAM_OBJ) $(BUILD)/libsquatch-dsp.a -ljack -lpthread

$(BUILD)/squatch-latency: hosts/jack/latency_probe.cpp $(HOST_HEADERS) | $(BUILD)
	$(CXX) $(HOST) -o $@ $< -ljack -lpthread

# The rig's chain over a recording, no JACK: any machine (squatch-rig-render IN.wav OUT.wav ...).
render: $(BUILD)/squatch-rig-render

$(BUILD)/squatch-rig-render: hosts/render/rig_render.cpp $(RIG_HEADERS) $(TUNER_HEADERS) $(BUILD)/libsquatch-dsp.a \
                             $(NAM_OBJ) $(BUILD)/rig.cfg | $(BUILD)
	$(CXX) $(HOST) $(RIG_NAM) -o $@ $< $(NAM_OBJ) $(BUILD)/libsquatch-dsp.a -lpthread

# The tuner over a recording as display-frame CSV rows (squatch-tuner-csv IN.wav > rows.csv), and
# the ESP32-S3 tuner probe's own code built for this machine (hosts/esp32/tuner-probe): any machine.
# The probe is development-tree only (tools/private-paths): without it only the CSV tool builds.
PROBE_HEADERS := $(wildcard hosts/esp32/tuner-probe/main/*.hpp)
PROBE := $(wildcard hosts/esp32/tuner-probe/main/probe_session.hpp)
tuner-csv: $(BUILD)/squatch-tuner-csv $(if $(PROBE),$(BUILD)/squatch-tuner-probe-host)

$(BUILD)/squatch-tuner-csv: hosts/render/tuner_csv.cpp $(HOST_HEADERS) $(TUNER_HEADERS) $(BUILD)/libsquatch-dsp.a | $(BUILD)
	$(CXX) $(HOST) -o $@ $< $(BUILD)/libsquatch-dsp.a

$(BUILD)/squatch-tuner-probe-host: hosts/esp32/tuner-probe/host/probe_host.cpp $(PROBE_HEADERS) $(HOST_HEADERS) \
                                   $(TUNER_HEADERS) $(BUILD)/libsquatch-dsp.a | $(BUILD)
	$(CXX) $(HOST) -o $@ $< $(BUILD)/libsquatch-dsp.a

# The display frames, the hold and the S3 probe's session and USB feed, with ASan and UBSan.
$(BUILD)/test_probe: hosts/tests/test_probe.cpp src/tuner.cpp $(PROBE_HEADERS) $(HOST_HEADERS) $(TUNER_HEADERS) | $(BUILD)
	$(CXX) $(HOST) -O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -o $@ $< src/tuner.cpp

# The rig's host code that needs no JACK (WAV reading, resampling, options), with ASan and UBSan.
$(BUILD)/test_rig: hosts/tests/test_rig.cpp hosts/common/ir_file.hpp hosts/jack/rig_options.hpp hosts/jack/rig_stages.hpp | $(BUILD)
	$(CXX) $(HOST) -O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -o $@ $<

# The browser demo (hosts/wasm): the tuner as WebAssembly in an AudioWorklet, a static folder
# for any HTTPS host. Needs Emscripten on PATH (source <emsdk>/emsdk_env.sh); not part of `all`.
# wasm-test scores the module in Node, then the page in headless Chrome against test tones.
DEMO := $(BUILD)/web-demo
wasm:
	python3 hosts/wasm/build.py $(DEMO)

wasm-test: wasm
	node hosts/web/hold.test.mjs
	node hosts/wasm/test/core.test.mjs $(DEMO)/tuner.wasm
	node hosts/wasm/test/browser.test.mjs --dir $(DEMO)

# The Pi bench's recording session page (hosts/pi/record-session: the standard tuner view with the
# session's controls) in headless Chrome, against a stand-in for the Pi's tuner. Needs node and Chrome.
record-session-test:
	node hosts/web/hold.test.mjs
	node hosts/pi/test/record-session.test.mjs

# Rewrites the demo screenshots in blocks/tuner/docs/screens/ (desktop and phone, light and dark).
wasm-shots: wasm
	node hosts/wasm/test/browser.test.mjs --dir $(DEMO) --only a2,a2-plus7 --shots blocks/tuner/docs/screens

# LV2 bundles for PiPedal (hosts/lv2): the macOS build and its smoke host (LV2 headers from a first
# `make lv2-linux`), and arm64 Linux in a Debian 12 container with its symbol, TTL and lv2lint checks.
lv2:
	$(MAKE) -C hosts/lv2 test

lv2-linux:
	hosts/lv2/build-linux.sh --lint

$(BUILD)/bench: bench/bench.cpp $(BUILD)/libsquatch-dsp.a $(HEADERS) | $(BUILD)
	$(CXX) $(RELEASE) -o $@ $< $(BUILD)/libsquatch-dsp.a

# Benches of their own (bench/bench_NAME.cpp): make build/bench_NAME
$(BUILD)/bench_%: bench/bench_%.cpp $(BUILD)/libsquatch-dsp.a $(HEADERS) | $(BUILD)
	$(CXX) $(RELEASE) -o $@ $< $(BUILD)/libsquatch-dsp.a

$(BUILD) $(BUILD)/obj:
	mkdir -p $@

test: $(BUILD)/tests $(BUILD)/test_queue_threads $(BUILD)/test_hosts $(BUILD)/test_rig $(if $(DAISY),$(BUILD)/test_daisy) $(if $(PROBE),$(BUILD)/test_probe)
	./$(BUILD)/tests
	./$(BUILD)/test_queue_threads
	./$(BUILD)/test_hosts
	./$(BUILD)/test_rig
	$(if $(PROBE),./$(BUILD)/test_probe)
	$(if $(DAISY),./$(BUILD)/test_daisy)
	$(MAKE) -C blocks/tuner test CXX=$(CXX)

# The tuner quality suite (blocks/tuner/bench/quality/README.md): every case through the display
# path the apps use (TunerBlock, 16- and 64-frame blocks, read 30 times a second, the page's hold),
# scored against its truth. Data stays outside the repository: name the DI corpus folder with
# TUNER_CORPUS=DIR, here or in an untracked local.mk; without it only the synthetic set runs.
-include local.mk
.PHONY: tuner-quality tuner-quality-test
QUALITY_DIR := blocks/tuner/bench/quality
QUALITY_HEADERS := $(wildcard $(QUALITY_DIR)/*.hpp) $(wildcard blocks/tuner/bench/*.hpp) hosts/common/display.hpp \
                   hosts/common/hold.hpp hosts/common/tuner_frames.hpp
TUNER_CORPUS ?=
QUALITY_OUT ?= $(BUILD)/tuner-quality
SCORECARD ?= $(QUALITY_OUT)/scorecard

$(BUILD)/tuner_quality: $(QUALITY_DIR)/quality.cpp $(QUALITY_HEADERS) $(TUNER_HEADERS) $(BUILD)/libsquatch-dsp.a | $(BUILD)
	$(CXX) $(HOST) -I. -o $@ $< $(BUILD)/libsquatch-dsp.a -lpthread

$(BUILD)/test_quality: $(QUALITY_DIR)/test_quality.cpp $(QUALITY_HEADERS) $(TUNER_HEADERS) src/tuner.cpp | $(BUILD)
	$(CXX) $(HOST) -I. -O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -o $@ $< src/tuner.cpp -lpthread

$(BUILD)/hold_parity: $(QUALITY_DIR)/hold_parity.cpp hosts/common/hold.hpp | $(BUILD)
	$(CXX) $(HOST) -I. -O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -o $@ $<

# The suite's own tests (reference estimator, display model, truth, MIDI) and hold.hpp against
# hold.js (needs node).
tuner-quality-test: $(BUILD)/test_quality $(BUILD)/hold_parity
	./$(BUILD)/test_quality
	node $(QUALITY_DIR)/hold_parity.mjs $(BUILD)/hold_parity

tuner-quality: $(BUILD)/tuner_quality
	./$(BUILD)/tuner_quality --out $(QUALITY_OUT) $(if $(TUNER_CORPUS),--corpus $(TUNER_CORPUS))
	python3 $(QUALITY_DIR)/score.py scorecard --run $(QUALITY_OUT) --out $(SCORECARD)

# Rewrites tests/golden/*.inc from the current code. Only after a deliberate change of sound.
golden: $(BUILD)/tests
	SQUATCH_WRITE_GOLDEN=tests/golden ./$(BUILD)/tests Golden
	$(MAKE) test

bench: $(BUILD)/bench
	mkdir -p results
	./$(BUILD)/bench "$$(sysctl -n machdep.cpu.brand_string 2>/dev/null || uname -m)" \
	  "$$($(CXX) --version | head -1)" > $(BENCH_OUT)
	cat $(BENCH_OUT)

# Each public header compiles on its own, with the core's flags.
headers:
	@for h in $(HEADERS); do \
	  printf '#include <%s>\n' "$${h#include/}" | $(CXX) $(CORE) -x c++ -fsyntax-only - || exit 1; \
	done; echo "headers: $(words $(HEADERS)) compile standalone"

# Complexity limits of the Squatch project kit: CCN 10, 60 lines, 5 parameters per function.
lint:
	@command -v lizard >/dev/null || { echo "lizard not found: this repo installs nothing"; exit 2; }
	lizard -C 10 -L 60 -a 5 -w -x 'hosts/clap/generated/*' -x 'hosts/daisy/vendor/*' -x 'tests/reference/*_faust.h' include src tests bench hosts tools/build-contracts blocks/tuner/include blocks/tuner/bench blocks/tuner/tests

ci: lint headers lib test contracts-check release-scan-test

# Control contracts (contracts/*.params.json) -> ParamDesc tables and the plugin list. `contracts`
# rewrites the generated files; `contracts-check` fails if they are stale.
contracts:
	tools/build-contracts --formats $(BUILD)/contracts

contracts-check:
	tools/build-contracts --check

# The desktop plugins (hosts/clap): CLAP, and VST3 and AUv2 through clap-wrapper, from the pinned
# dependencies in hosts/clap/deps.lock (fetched into build/deps; nothing downloads during a build).
PLUGIN_BUILD := $(BUILD)/plugins
plugins:
	tools/fetch-plugin-deps
	cmake -S hosts/clap -B $(PLUGIN_BUILD) -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
	cmake --build $(PLUGIN_BUILD)

# Copies the bundles into $HOME/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/{CLAP,VST3,Components} (macOS).
plugins-install: plugins
	for pair in clap:CLAP vst3:VST3 component:Components; do \
	  mkdir -p "$$HOME/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/$${pair#*:}"; \
	  for b in $(PLUGIN_BUILD)/bundles/*."$${pair%%:*}"; do \
	    rm -rf "$$HOME/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/$${pair#*:}/$$(basename "$$b")"; \
	    ditto "$$b" "$$HOME/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/$${pair#*:}/$$(basename "$$b")"; \
	  done; \
	done
	-killall -9 AudioComponentRegistrar 2>/dev/null

# The whole plugin matrix: test host (linked and over the bundles) under ASan+UBSan, TSan and
# RTSan, clap-validator, the VST3 validator, pluginval and auval. See tools/plugins-check.
plugins-check:
	tools/plugins-check

# The development tree keeps some work out of the public export (tools/private-paths). This
# proves the export leaves it out and that the exported tree builds and passes its tests.
# The release scanner's own tests, each guard with its negative control.
release-scan-test:
	tools/test-release-scan
	tools/test-release-signing

export-check:
	@if [ -x tools/check-private-export ]; then tools/check-private-export; else echo "export-check: nothing private here"; fi

clean:
	rm -rf $(BUILD)
```

================================================================================
FILE: blocks/tuner/results/perf.md    [Optional: Squatch Tuner: CPU cost]
================================================================================

# Squatch Tuner: CPU cost

| algorithm | ns/sample playing | of one core @48k | ns/sample quiet | of one core @48k |
|---|---|---|---|---|

<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT -->
# squatch-dsp CPU benchmark

Apple M1 Max, Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.3.34.2), `-O3 -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti`, 2026-09-26.
`make bench` writes this file.

Nanoseconds per sample at 48 kHz, by block size (best of 7 runs of 10 s of audio, one core).
At 48 kHz one core has 20833 ns per sample; the last column is that share at 128.

| block | 16 | 32 | 64 | 128 | % of a core |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| limiter (limiting) | 69.58 | 69.05 | 68.94 | 68.48 | 0.33% |
| gate (open) | 4.75 | 4.74 | 4.75 | 4.74 | 0.02% |
| eq (3 bands) | 6.30 | 8.23 | 10.62 | 11.86 | 0.06% |
| gate + eq + limiter | 90.76 | 85.79 | 87.69 | 87.77 | 0.42% |
| tuner (tracking 110 Hz) | 134.99 | 134.31 | 134.53 | 134.84 | 0.65% |
| cabinet (200 ms response, partition 64) | 80.19 | 80.32 | 79.76 | 80.10 | 0.39% |
| comp (4:1) | 9.88 | 9.91 | 9.77 | 9.81 | 0.05% |
| trail od (4x oversampled) | 15.80 | 15.57 | 15.48 | 15.34 | 0.07% |
| crunch (high-gain preamp, 4x oversampled) | 153.75 | 152.11 | 152.35 | 152.99 | 0.73% |
| claw (op-amp distortion circuit model, 4x oversampled) | 243.49 | 242.44 | 242.51 | 242.54 | 1.17% |
| hall (FDN reverb, 8 lines) | 13.39 | 13.40 | 13.25 | 13.11 | 0.06% |
